important: Only recommended items are unqualified primary-photo suggestions. Conditional and reserve files are NOT claimed to satisfy the premium brief; they are transparently retained for art-direction judgment. Do not count them as ten suitable originals.
gaps: Did not verify ten distinct premium modern Nigerian corporate/metropolitan photographs at this native minimum.
No professional/workspace people source passed both dimensions: the verified team, laptop and tech-community originals were narrower than 3840 pixels.
No pristine modern Ibadan corporate tower hero verified; the best Ibadan architectural option is weathered institutional modernism.
Only one strong dusk infrastructure photo; the other night/sunset reserves are a watermarked monument and a distant city silhouette.
reuse_notes: For CC BY-SA photographs: retain appropriate author credit and license link; indicate cropping or other changes, and preserve applicable share-alike terms for adapted photographs.
Visible business/place branding and recognizable people must not imply partnership or endorsement. Model/property releases were not separately verified.
Unsplash images are not CC0 despite some generic topic tags saying Creative Commons; use the stated Unsplash License.
A source-original dimension check is not a claim to possess the camera RAW file. No downloaded original was upscaled or altered.
